heading: College Admissions Consulting in Fairfield County, CT
lede: Strategic, end-to-end guidance for ambitious high school students targeting top national universities and liberal arts colleges.
introHeading: Regional admissions consulting with dedicated personal focus
introParagraphs: Fairfield County students often pursue ambitious academic and extracurricular paths, preparing for competitive university admissions. Developing a distinctive application requires clear purpose, genuine intellectual vitality, and an authentic personal voice.

Based in New Canaan, Evergreen Admissions Consulting works with families across Fairfield County—including New Canaan, Darien, Greenwich, Westport, Wilton, Ridgefield, and Stamford. Founder Andrea Schiralli (Harvard M.Ed., Cornell B.A.) directly advises clients from initial school selection through final submission.
stagesHeading: The five stages of the admissions journey
stagesSubtitle: A structured framework taking students from early planning to confident submission.

stages.title: Diagnostic & school list strategy
stages.description: Evaluating academic interests, extracurricular strengths, and target programs. Curating a balanced list of Reach, Target, and Likely colleges that reflect true fit rather than simple rankings, ensuring families have strong options in the spring.

stages.title: Timeline & early application strategy
stages.description: Navigating Early Decision (ED), Early Action (EA), Restricted EA, and Regular Decision deadlines. Structuring milestones starting in spring of junior year so that major writing is completed before the demanding fall semester.

stages.title: Personal statement & narrative development
stages.description: Transforming individual stories and formative experiences into a compelling Common App essay. Brainstorming, outlining, and refining drafts so the student’s intellectual curiosity and core personality resonate on the page.

stages.title: Supplemental essays & institutional fit
stages.description: Tailoring school-specific essays, 'Why This College' statements, and program-specific prompts. Researching campus offerings to ensure every supplement demonstrates authentic interest and deep institutional knowledge.

stages.title: Holistic review & interview preparation
stages.description: Conducting final multi-pass reviews of the full application—including activity descriptions and honors. One-on-one mock interview sessions build poise and conversational confidence before alumni conversations.

packagesSubtitle: From comprehensive senior-year advisement to focused essay reviews.

faqSubtitle: Common questions from Fairfield County families about independent admissions consulting.

faqs.question: What does comprehensive college admissions consulting cover?
faqs.answer: Comprehensive consulting covers the entire lifecycle of the college application: assessing academic and extracurricular profiles, building balanced school lists, planning Early Decision/Early Action strategy, developing the Common App personal statement and all supplements, polishing the activities list and résumé, and preparing for alumni interviews.

faqs.question: How does an independent consultant complement high school counselors?
faqs.answer: High school guidance counselors manage dozens or hundreds of students and perform vital roles submitting transcripts and school reports. An independent consultant provides dedicated, proactive 1-on-1 attention—spending focused time brainstorming, outlining, and editing individual essays, refining school lists, and keeping students ahead of deadlines.

faqs.question: How does video collaboration work for local families?
faqs.answer: Sessions take place via video conference combined with real-time shared Google Docs. This format allows focused line-by-line editorial collaboration, screen sharing, and recorded interview practice, while fitting seamlessly into busy after-school schedules.

faqs.question: When is the best time for juniors or sophomores to begin?
faqs.answer: The ideal time to begin comprehensive packages is the winter or spring of junior year. This timing allows families to finalize school lists, determine test submission strategies, and draft primary essays over the summer before senior coursework and extracurricular responsibilities begin.

faqs.question: Does Evergreen assist with graduate school or transfer applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. In addition to undergraduate packages, Andrea works with transfer applicants and graduate candidates drafting statements of purpose and personal statements for master’s, MBA, law, medical, and PhD programs. Details are available on the graduate services section.
